title: Cognitive Dysfunction Syndrome

content_blocks.text: Syndrome associated with brain aging. Leads to alterations in awareness, decreased responsiveness to stimuli, deficits in learning and memory, agitation, and anxiety. Subtle signs seen in early stages of cognitive decline may include alterations in activity, social interactions and increasing anxiety.
